updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.0.4 RC
- Add George AI support for the AH-64D (phase 1 CPG).
- Add combined AI CREW controls on the VAICOM UI Extensions tab.
- Adds dynamic keyword support for AI_ATC Andersen 2.0.
- Adds dynamic keyword support for the updated Sentry Pacific 25 Campaign F-16C.
- Adds dynamic keyword support for the upcoming Sentry Pacific 26 Campaign A-10C II.
- Adds new Single PTT logic for UH-1H Huey.
- Fixes radio tuning on the UH-1H Huey UHF radio.
- Adds new Single PTT logic for Mi-24P Hind.
- Fixes radio tuning on the Mi-24P Hind radio with channel change.
- Adds commands for Kneeboard tab browsing (Show Next Tab / Show Previous Tab).
- Fixes Kneeboard "Clear Notes" command; now clears notes regardless of dictate state.
- Fixes Jester AI link host commands; Jester now selects the correct DL host.
- Adds DDG Arleigh Burke as selectable DL host for F-14A/B Jester AI.
- Fixes nav grid handling for F-14A/B Jester AI.
- Fixes an issue where rapid PTT presses caused a race condition in listening state and state desync.
- Fixes minor graphical errors with Dark Mode.
